links.note: asks the bhaav of 'बिरह भुवंगम तन बसै, मन्त्र न लागै कोय' -- the virah-as-serpent sakhi, whose gloss concept is bhuvangam; not 25042 aapa, which belongs to the deepak sakhi
who failed to become gyani: the reader of fat books -- 'पोथी पढ़ि-पढ़ि जग मुआ' exactly, so पोथी और अक्षर rather than the general 25029 baahya aadambar
how the lamp dispels darkness -- the marked answer names अहंकार रूपी माया, so this is the aapa/deepak sakhi, not 25032 anubhav gyan
birth 1398 at Kashi -- verbatim from जन्म और गुरु, which carries both the date and Ramanand
purpose of the sakhis is to teach the right way of living; शिक्षा का प्रभाव is the didactic-transmission concept, whereas 25031 प्रत्यक्ष ज्ञान is the word-meaning of साक्षी

the four languages listed in the options (Awadhi, Rajasthani, Bhojpuri, Punjabi) are the description of अनेक भाषाओं का प्रभाव verbatim; 25034 पंचमेल खिचड़ी is the label that follows from it, not the list
meaning of साक्ष्य = प्रत्यक्ष ज्ञान, which is exactly 25031; 25030 is the etymology साक्षी>साखी, a different step
tadbhav-rup question on साक्षी/साखी -- the etymology concept, even though this row's marked option has the direction reversed
'कवि कैसा प्रकाश फैलाना चाहते हैं' -> ज्ञान का; the light-within is the deepak of the aapa sakhi, so 25042 rather than the generic 25032
gloss of 'अषिर' = अक्षर, the word from 'एकै अषिर पीव का' in the पोथी और अक्षर sakhi
what Ram and kasturi share -- both reside within; that is the kasturi-mrig simile itself
कुंडलि = नाभि, the navel in 'कस्तूरी कुंडलि बसै'; belongs to 25040 and not to 25043 घटि घटि, the other gloss from the same sakhi
the state of the birahi -- no remedy touches him; the second line of the bhuvangam sakhi
'जिवै तो बौरा होइ' is the closing line of the same bhuvangam sakhi
'मन का आपा खोने' -> त्यागना अहंकार; the concept is literally the gloss of आपा
effect of sweet speech on others -- 25039 says it gives others sukh, which is the marked option
साखी as tadbhav of साक्षी -- the etymology concept
'साखी क्या है' -> दोहा छंद, which is 25036; 25037 is the matra count inside the doha, a further step
Kabir's guru -- जन्म और गुरु names Ramanand
'ईश्वर कण कण में व्याप्त है' quotes the gloss of घटि घटि (कण-कण में) directly; 25040 is the kasturi simile, this row is on the phrase
